properties.title: Aid to Navigation Outage
properties.body:
[South-eastern Baltic] LITHUANIAN NAV WARN 068/26
SOUTH-EASTERN BALTIC
APPROACHES TO PORT KLAIPEDA – BUOY
STARBOARD HAND LIGHT-BUOY „3“(0005.1) 55-43.86N 021-02.91E, UNLIT.
RADAR TRANSPONDER BEACON, RACON MO(P), OUT OF ORDER.
MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO NAVIGATE WITH CAUTION.
CANCEL LITHUANIAN NAV WARN 061(T)/26.
